senses.sense_definition: To make a political system or organization democratic.

examples.text: The new government promised to <w>democratize</w> the country after years of military rule.
It is difficult to <w>democratize</w> institutions that have been controlled by a single leader for decades.

senses.sense_definition: To make something available or accessible to a wider range of people.

examples.text: The internet has helped to <w>democratize</w> information by making knowledge free for everyone.
New technology aims to <w>democratize</w> access to high-quality education for students in remote areas.
